pattern: keep groups whose derived change is negative, null rounds drop out
question: in which districts did women literacy go down from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5
gold_sql: SELECT "District" FROM district_health_factsheet WHERE "District" <> 'State Total' GROUP BY "District" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) ORDER BY "District"
sql_duckdb: SELECT "District", "State" FROM "district_health_factsheet" WHERE "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5') AND "Source" = 'District factsheet' GROUP BY "District", "State" HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END) < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END)

in which districts did women literacy go down from NFHS-4 to NFHS-5
attempts.response:
SELECT "District", "State"
FROM "district_health_factsheet"
WHERE "Survey Round" IN ('NFHS-4', 'NFHS-5')
  AND "Source" = 'District factsheet'
GROUP BY "District", "State"
HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-5' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END)
     < MAX(CASE WHEN "Survey Round" = 'NFHS-4' THEN "Women age 15-49 years who are literate (%)" END);
